scripts.stop: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),{execSync}=require('child_process');const cfg=fs.existsSync('./config.txt')?fs.readFileSync('./config.txt','utf-8'):'PORT=3333';const port=(cfg.match(/^PORT=(.+)/m)||[,'3333'])[1].trim();try{const pid=execSync('lsof -ti tcp:'+port).toString().trim();if(pid){execSync('kill -9 '+pid);console.log('Proxy encerrado (PID '+pid+')');}else{console.log('Nenhum processo na porta '+port);}}catch{console.log('Nenhum processo encontrado.');}"
